review_method: Rendered all source images with their YOLO bounding boxes overlaid in contact sheets and visually reviewed all sheets.

content_findings.image_subject: All reviewed images show strawberry plants in growing settings; no unrelated image was apparent.
content_findings.boxes: Bounding boxes generally correspond to visible strawberry fruit. No conspicuous class or image-label mismatch was observed at contact-sheet scale. Some small, partly obscured targets are difficult to judge at this scale; this was not a pixel-level annotation adjudication.
content_findings.people: No clearly identifiable people or faces were apparent in the full contact-sheet review.
content_findings.backgrounds: Images show cultivated beds, ground, and crop covering. No location was inferred.

technical_findings: The existing archive audit reports 247 decoded images with matching annotation files and two boxes extending about 0.005 pixel beyond the image edge due to tiny normalized-coordinate overflow. This visual review does not change the strict converter result for those rows.

rights_review.status: redistribution and artifact preparation remain on hold pending rights clarification

release_decision: Do not create a mirrored artifact or enable the library API while the upstream rights conflict remains unresolved. Visual inspection does not establish redistribution permission.
